info.title: The Yuzuki Family’s Four Sons
info.synopsis: La storia è incentrata sulla vita quotidiana dei 4 fratelli della famiglia Yuzuki. Sono una famiglia, degli amici, ma a volte anche dei rivali!

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: The Yuzuki brothers, consisting of the eldest son, Hayato; the second son, Mikoto; the third son, Minato; and the youngest, Gakuto, have been living together since they lost their parents two years ago.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Minato and Mikoto are barely a year apart in age, which means they study together, and Mikoto has always been considered the older one. Why did his younger brother take everything from him at birth? Is there any resentment between these two brothers? What does it mean to be an older brother?

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Gakuto spends a lot of time with the Kirishimas, but it wasn't always this way. Shortly after their parents' deaths, Hayato tried to handle everything on his own, running home from university every day to be there when Gakuto came home from kindergarten. One day, he noticed Kirishima-san's grim looks.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Hayato is looking forward to his class reunion. But his former classmates complain about work and brag about their travels, while he only talks about his brothers. He feels left behind by life...

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Uta and Minato are best friends. One day, a classmate declares his love for Uta. The two arrange a date. How will Minato react?

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Minato no longer knows how to deal with Uta. Uta, for her part, isn't approaching Minato like she usually does. What will become of their friendship and Uta's relationship?

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Minato first met his best friend Uta when they were elementary school students. Uta, who moved next to the Yuzuki family, responded coldly to Minato and Mikoto. Determined to become friends with Uta no matter what, Minato enthusiastically keeps inviting them to play, but...

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: A class observation day was scheduled to be held in Gaku's class. However, Gaku was worried that if Hayato took a day off to attend, it would cause inconvenience at his workplace and increase his workload.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Gakuto is keeping his class observation day from Hayato by using a stand-in.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: The Yuzuki family's four brothers cherish each other deeply. Among them, the second son, Mikoto, dotes on Minato, the third son, while Minato, in turn, adores Gakuto, the youngest.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Hayato catches a cold. Mikoto, Minato, and Gakuto are eager to care for Hayato and handle the household chores. Even when they run into the Kirishima family on their way to a trip, they keep Hayato's condition a secret, not wanting to worry them before their vacation.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Gakuto won a diary. Wondering what to write as the entry, Mikoto mentions, "You can also write about your thoughts and feelings." Encouraged by this, Gakuto chronicles the daily happenings in the Yuzuki household...

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: It's business as usual at Café Terrace Familia, and the girls are coming to terms with their own feelings for Hayato. But then, a sinister quintet appear with their own designs to crush the café... and something new about the past is revealed.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Ouka realizes that all six of the current Familia staff are the grandkids of the six waitresses who once worked at Hayato's grandpa's coffee shop. Could it really be just a coincidence? Meanwhile, Fuwa opens a new café restaurant called Family...

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: The Familia crew counters Fuwa's Family by wearing Halloween costumes designed by Ouka and releasing an attention-grabbing new menu item created by Shiragiku. Riho also makes up her mind to defend Familia using a weapon unique to her...

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Family's reputation plummets after Ririka's accidental livestream. Enraged, Fuwa shuts the restaurant down and forces the five waitresses out of their living quarters. When Riho learns of their plight, she asks Hayato to let them stay at Familia.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Café Restaurant Family reopens as Chiyoda Diner, and the Familia crew are among the first to sample its Japanese-style cuisine. As they're leaving, Ririka gives Riho a ticket for two to a hot spring inn. Will Riho finally get some alone time with Hayato?

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Ami heads to the senior home, but her grandma still remains expressionless and pushes her away. Ami breaks down crying. Then Hayato remembers a dream he had last night involving his own grandparents...

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Ami decides to stay with her grandma, so the rest of the Familia crew stays a second night in an old inn that looks more like a haunted house. Hayato just wants to sleep, but the girls aren't going to make it easy for him...

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Hayato wants to get Shiragiku a birthday gift, even though he's two weeks late. Akane helps him choose one, and on their way home, he remembers that today is Akane's birthday. He offers to buy her a gift as an apology, but she only wants one thing...

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Riho gets an offer to appear in a drama. While she's away filming, a man dressed in all black and sunglasses enters Familia and waits alone for six hours. Suspicious, Ami tries to drive him away, but then Riho returns and takes a look at the stranger...

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: The girls want to plan a Christmas party together, right as competition for Hayato's affection begins to really heat up.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: After seeing Akane boldly kiss Hayato in front of everyone, Riho is dead-set on getting her own kiss from him, but she wants the scenario to be just perfect. She drags him around town to find the ideal setting for a kiss, but nothing seems good enough...

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: As the Familia crew enjoys their New Year's dinners from Chiyoda Diner, Hayato announces his decision to quit college and officially take over Familia. Ouka follows his announcement with one of her own.

info.title: Honkai: Star Rail - A Flash

Nel 8096, Yanqing, un giovane soldato, divenne famoso grazie a un torneo organizzato dal Trono della Divina Lungimiranza e ottenne il titolo di Tenente dei Cavalieri delle Nuvole. "Gli anni passano in un lampo, e solo il vino offre consolazione." Il maestro e l'allievo si scontrano con spade veloci come il tempo che scorre. Sebbene il duello con la sua maestra sia avvenuto secoli fa, Yanqing lo ricorda come se fosse ieri. Tuttavia, gli anni recenti passati con il suo giovane allievo sembrano infiniti. episodes.synopsis: LEGITのライブが終わっても、PROTOSTARはまだリリースバトルのモチーフを決められずにいた。 そんな時、万里のもとに地元・島根の地域PRイベントへの出演依頼が届く。 身内からきた相談ということもありどうしたらいいか迷っている万里に、3人にとっても”いい機会だ”と送り出す凛と真音。 準備万端で挑んだイベント会場に広がっていたのは3人が想像していたものとは違う景色で……。

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: アメリカで開催されるジャズライブへの出演オファーがあった楽翔。海外でも自分らしく活動をこなす楽翔とは裏腹に、ほまれ、一澄、潤、奏太の4人はなぜか仕事で思うように動けずにいた。 楽翔の存在の大きさを改めて自覚した4人だったが、楽翔がいない分を補うため、さらに力を入れて活動に励むように。 そんな中、JAXX/JAXXが5人揃って参加する「生バズバラエティ」のダンス企画の撮影が迫り、全員で頑張ろうと意気込んでいた4人のもとに、凛からあることを知らされる──。

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: ほまれ、一澄、潤、奏太の4人で挑んだ「生バズバラエティ」は、本人たちの想像を大きく超えた盛り上がりを見せた。 バズったことを嬉しく思いつつも、楽翔が複雑な気持ちを抱えているのではないかと気にかける奏太。 そんな奏太に対して潤は、ある日を境になぜかいたずらを仕掛けるように。奏太はその理由に心当たりがない様子だが、どうやら潤は奏太に気が付いてほしいことがあるようで……?!

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: リリースライブもついにPROTOSTARを残すのみとなっていた。LEGITとJAXX/JAXXの集計結果を見ながら、PROTOSTARがどんなライブを見せてくれるのかを話す凛と真音は、sMiLeaプロダクションを発足した当時では考えられなかったことだと振り返る。伝説のアイドルからプロデューサーへの転身で起こった知られざる過去が明らかに。 一方で明良を中心とした所属アイドルたちは、凛、真音、晴美に隠れてなにやら不穏な動きを見せていて……。

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: PROTOSTARは次なる巡業先である「ランタン祭り」のために準備を進めていた。 昔は地元の人に愛されていた祭りだったが、あることをきっかけに祭りのあり方が変わってしまっていた。 変わってしまった祭りに対して距離を感じている地元の人を、万里と千紘は自身のファンと重ね合わせて見るように。 祭りに参加する全員が笑顔になる方法を探していたPROTOSTARが出した結論とは……?!

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: 「ランタン祭り」での経験を経て、ついにリリースバトルのモチーフが決まったPROTOSTAR。 それぞれのユニットが自分自身やメンバーと向き合い、想いを込めて作り上げたリリースバトルのステージで、最高の輝きを見せたのは一体どのユニットなのか。 凛と真音がリリースバトルを通じて3組に伝えたかったこととは――。

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis:
The sMiLea Production idols are suddenly sent to an overnight training camp by Lin and Maoto. Although they're enjoying their stay by having snowball fights and doing other activities, PROTOSTAR began feeling overwhelmed by the responsibility and pressure of leading the joint live performance.

When Daiki sees the three members of PROTOSTAR lack the confidence to direct the senior groups, LEGIT and JAXX/JAXX, he begins venting about his frustrations.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: PROTOSTAR, LEGIT, and JAXX/JAXX form a deeper bond with the overnight training camp. As they work on improving for the joint performance, Akira strangely shows up late to practice. Banri and Chihiro are worried about Akira, who isn't acting like himself. They head to Kikunoyu Hot Springs to talk to him when they realize Akira's mother isn't there. After wondering if there is any way they can support Akira, what will Banri and Chihiro do?!

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: With the help of all the idols at sMiLea Production, Akira is able to perform at the joint concert.

info.title: Kabukibu!
info.synopsis: La serie ruota intorno al kabuki, uno stile di danza classica giapponese che combina musica, drama e ballo. Kurogo Kurusu, uno studente di quindici anni, ha una passione per il kabuki e spera di riuscire a fondare un club di kabuki presso la sua scuola. Ma le cose non sono facili come sembrano: la parte più difficile sarà  trovare qualche altro studente disposto a seguirlo...

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Nestled in the sleepy countryside lies Kasamatsu Tracen Academy. Jo Kitahara, a trainer, can't help but bemoan the state of regional races compared to the star-studded national scene. But one day, as he passively watches the newest batch of racers practice, he spots an ashen-haired Umamusume. After seeing her stunning racing form, Jo Kitahara is convinced—at long last, he's found a star.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Oguri Cap and Belno Light are officially scouted by Jo Kitahara. Seeing as a racer needs to belong to a team in order to race, Oguri Cap accepts and begins training for her debut race. When the day arrives, she finds the student hailed as their generation's ace—Fujimasa March—waiting for her...

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Up until now, Oguri Cap has simply run because she can, but after her heated race with Fujimasa March, her heart wells with a new, bitter emotion. As Oguri Cap and her team ensure she's properly prepared for her next race, another opponent shows her face: Norn Ace. Annoyed by Oguri Cap, Norn Ace's friends propose a certain "strategy" to her...

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: The day of the Junior Crown is here, and Oguri Cap and Fujimasa March make good on the promise they made at Mt. Kinka to enter. While Oguri Cap had no answer when Fujimasa March asked her for her goal back then, her aspirations will surely take shape during this race with her rival.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Oguri Cap and the rest of her team make their way to Chukyo Racecourse for the Chukyo Hai, but Kitahara can't shake Musaka's ominous words from his mind. Brows furrowed, he heads for the stands, only to discover Symboli Rudolf and Maruzensky have come to observe the race.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: After Symboli Rudolf offers his trainee a place in the Twinkle Series, Kitahara approaches a reluctant Oguri Cap with a wager—if she wins the Gold Junior, she'll transfer to the nationals; otherwise, they'll aim for the Tokai Derby. As she heads into the race, Oguri Cap remains conflicted. She wants to give her all in her long-awaited battle against March, but...

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Musaka gives Tracen Academy's two newest students—Oguri Cap and Belno Light—a tour of the expansive campus. Afterwards, Oguri Cap comes face to face with her new classmates—and potential rivals. As class begins, the teacher explains the goal of many of her contemporaries, the G1 Classic Triple Crown. There's just one problem...

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Oguri Cap's transfer from Kasamatsu has unfortunately overlapped with the registration deadline for the Classic races. Eager to show Symboli Rudolf she has what it takes to take on these races, she sets her sights on the G3 Pegasus Stakes. But standing in her way is a racer with four consecutive wins under her belt...

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Symboli Rudolf witnesses Oguri Cap's might firsthand—the no-name racer from the boonies wipes the floor with even the strong national racers. In her, Symboli Rudolf sees a star capable of setting the Twinkle Series alight. But should she use her authority to advocate for a miracle at the Japan Derby, or should she remain loyal to the rules?

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Ultimately, Oguri Cap is unable to enter the Japanese Derby, which means she needs a new racing goal. Hoping to inspire Oguri Cap, Musaka takes her and Belno Light to see the Takarazuka Kinen, a Grand Prix race where the lineup is decided by a fan poll. There, Oguri Cap witnesses the racer currently dominating the Twinkle Series.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Musaka declares that if Oguri Cap wants to take on Tamamo Cross in the fall Tenno Sho, she has to win the Mainichi Okan. A task easier said than done, as Oguri Cap's winning streak means all her rivals' eyes are on her. This year's Mainichi Okan is shaping up to be a ten-versus-one race...

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: At last, the day of the fall Tenno Sho arrives, and with it, the first clash between the two ashen-haired Umamusume, Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap. Hoping to surpass the top racer and become the best in all of Japan, Oguri Cap steps onto the turf. Although Tamamo Cross holds a similar dream, there's a special someone in her heart as she enters the course.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: The crowd is on the edge of their seats as the racers enter the homestretch of the fall Tenno Sho. With 400 meters remaining, each runner musters their last strength. With Oguri Cap on her tail, Tamamo Cross feels the pressure. As exhaustion creeps in, her past flashes before her eyes. Her loved ones in her heart, Tamamo Cross breaks her limits and enters a zone beyond her rivals...

info.title: Modest Heroes: Ponoc Short Films Theatre, Volume 1 (ITA)
info.synopsis: Lo Studio Ponoc, studio d'animazione giapponese fondato nel 2015 dagli ex di Studio Ghibli Hiromasa Yonebayashi (regista di Arrietty - Il mondo segreto sotto il pavimento, Quando c'era Marnie e Mary and the Witch's Flower) e Yoshiaki Nishimura (produttore de Il castello errante di Howl, La storia della principessa splendende e Quando c'era Marnie) realizza il progetto di un'antologia di corti. Si tratta del Ponoc Short Films Theater (Ponoc Tanpen Gekijo), che si compone di due "Volumi" dalle diverse tematiche. Il primo volume è Modest Heroes (Chiisana Eiyuu: Kani to Tamago to Toumei Ningen), che si compone a sua volta di tre diversi brevi episodi di circa 15 minuti diretti ognuno da tre diversi registi: Kanini & Kanino ("Kani no Kanino") da Hiromasa Yonebayashi, un fantasy con protagonisti due fratelli "granchi"; Life Ain't Gonna Lose ("Samurai Egg") da Yoshiyuki Momose, una commovente storia d'amore materno; Invisible ("Toumei Ningen") da Akihiko Yamashita, uno "spettacolare" action incentrato sulla lotta solitaria un uomo invisibile.

info.title: Spring and Chaos
info.synopsis: Mediometraggio ispirato alla vita del letterato Kenji Miyazawa, film molto stilizzato che prende spunto dalle tecniche di scrittura di Miyazawa per raccontarne la storia. Miyazawa ha usato spesso degli animali come personaggi nelle sue storie e poesie, con questo espediente il regista Shoji Kawamori ricrea la terra di Ihatov e la utilizza come sfondo per il racconto biografico.

info.title: Captivated, By You
info.synopsis: La storia si forma attraverso i racconti paralleli e incrociati di alcuni giovani liceali: Hayashi Miyoshi non è colui che si definirebbe il classico normale studente poiché non disdegna ingenue eccentricità. Il ragazzo ama affrontare la vita seguendo il proprio ritmo e rimanendo impassibilmente fedele a se stesso, nonostante ciò che gli altri potrebbero pensare di lui. Proprio tale franchezza, in verità, fa sì che Miyoshi abbia la capacità di attirare discretamente l'attenzione delle persone, anche senza volerlo. Mentre lui abbraccia il lato più leggero della vita e attira gli altri verso quella luce, il liceale Akira Nikaido fa esattamente il contrario: il ragazzo ha lavorato duramente per costruirsi una maschera oscura, attraverso cui tenere gli altri lontani. Nikaido trasuda tristezza e malinconia e chiunque considera la sua presenza un cattivo presagio, tranne il compagno di classe Medaka: dopo aver scorto il ragazzo dietro la maschera, Medaka è determinato a scalfirla per far uscire il compagno dal guscio e riportarlo alla luce.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: On his way to visit the Queen of the Garden of Light, the Sage of the Garden of Clouds accidentally drops the egg of the Houhou. The egg lands in the Garden of Rainbows, where it is found by Hikari, attracting the attention of a powerful pair of servants of the Dark Lord.

info.title: Dusk Beyond the End of the World
info.synopsis: Akira è uno studente delle superiori che si sottopone al sonno criogenico e si risveglia 200 anni dopo in un mondo devastato dalla guerra. Ora una nuova organizzazione unificata nota come OWEL governa l'intera umanita, ed un nuovo sistema chiamato "Elsie" ha sostituito il matrimonio. Ma la prima cosa che vede Akira al suo risveglio è Yugure, un'androide che assomiglia in modo impressionante alla sua ragazza Towasa. In quel momento riceve una richiesta che lo lascia confuso e disorientato: una repentina proposta di matrimonio dell'androide. Nonostante questo Akira è convinto che la sua ragazza possa ancora esistere in qualche forma anche in questo mondo, quindi decide di partire per un viaggio alla ricerca della sua amata affiancato da Yugure.

episodes.title: Colei che ha salpato con l'animo nel mare di stelle
episodes.synopsis: Akira is a stranger in a strange land. As the locals decide his fate, he must learn what happened to Towasa and the world that left him behind.

episodes.title: In the North After Doomsday
episodes.synopsis: Akira needs answers. But between an android insisting on marriage and an aspiring storybook artist, his search for the past may lead him somewhere entirely unexpected instead.

episodes.title: Dancing with You Under the Rainy Summer Sky
episodes.synopsis: Despite Yugure's protests, Akira can't leave Amoru in the hands of OWEL. But a high-stakes rescue is the least of their troubles.

episodes.title: A Game of Lime and Allegiance
episodes.synopsis: Akira and Yugure are drawn into a double date as well as family baggage.

episodes.title: Do Androids Dream of Electric Doves?
episodes.synopsis: Akira learns more about the AI War.

episodes.title: The Machine That Shouted Love at the End of the World
episodes.synopsis: Love is a complicated emotion. As Akira and Yugure go on a date, Amoru must wrestle with her jealousy.

episodes.title: Paper Songs of a Budding Primate
episodes.synopsis: Amoru's desperate search for her parent's banned storybooks leads her and Akira to a secured library.

episodes.title: To the Ocean Horizon Descends a Treacherous Swallow
episodes.synopsis: Akira's group hide from OWEL after escaping the library.

episodes.title: Overlooking the Expanse of Days Past
episodes.synopsis: They say true love conquers all, but sometimes, even love isn't enough. Especially when secrets and lies threaten to tear people apart.

episodes.title: His and Her Long Afternoon
episodes.synopsis: A single act of violence shattered Akira and Towasa's lives in the distant past, yet time marches on. What happened after that fateful day of the shooting?

episodes.title: "Don`t Cry," She Said
episodes.synopsis: Amaru wants to be with Akira and Yugure, but circumstances make that an impossibility. But what if there was a way to make her wish come true?

episodes.title: Your Love Belongs to You
episodes.synopsis: Love is as messy as it is transformative. It can drive people to selfish extremes just as much as it can drive them to heroic sacrifice. In the end, what does love mean to Akira and Yugure?

info.title: Time Bokan 24
info.synopsis: Remake della prima serie di Time Bokan risalente al 1975. In questo nuovo anime invece siamo nel 24° secolo e il protagonista è Tokio, uno studente delle medie repentinamente assunto nell'amministrazione Spazio-Tempo. Si è scoperto che improvvisamente i libri e gli annali riportano eventi storici molto diversi rispetto a quelli universalmente noti, e Tokio parte così con la partner Calen sulla 24 Bokan Mecha per ripristinare il corso della storia. I due se la dovranno vedere con la banda della History Paradise, un editore che vuole mantenere la storia com'è per vendere libri.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: いつものように遅刻をして走っていたトキオは、突然空から落ちてきたスーパーメカ、メカブトンを操縦するカレンに連れられ24世紀へ。教科書に載っている歴史はウソという事実を知らされ、時空管理局の一員として『真歴史』を見つける事になる。最初の任務先は古代エジプト。見えてきたのはなんと、お笑いステージ!?

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: ライト兄弟の真歴史を探しに、1903年のアメリカ・ノースカロライナ州へとやってきたトキオとカレン。そこで出会ったライトは、なんと自転車の『ライト』だけを作っていた。アクダーマは教科書通りの歴史にしようと、ライトを飛行機で飛ばそうと悪だくみ。何やらツブヤッキーには作戦があるらしくて…。

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: 真歴史を探しに、鬼ヶ島へとやって来たトキオとカレン。すると川から桃が『どんぶらこ』と流れてきた…って赤鬼のお尻!? 鬼よりも鬼なヤツに身包みを剥がされたと、泣きだす赤鬼。案内された先は軽快な音楽が響くライブステージ。女鬼たちが夢中になっていたのは…イケメン桃太郎!?

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: 中生代のジャングルへやって来たトキオとカレン。いきなり茂みから恐竜が飛び出してきて大ピンチ!? ところが、よく見ると頭にリボンが付いていて…なんと恐竜は人間のペットだった。トキオはティラノサウルスを飼いたいと捕獲に乗り出すが、逆にメカブトンを捕られちゃった！ このままじゃ元の時代に帰れない!?

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: 今回はハロウィンの真歴史。ところが、着いた先は明治4年の鳥取砂丘。司会者『福澤さん』と出会ったトキオとカレン。鳥取と島根は間違えられる事が多いらしく、正確に覚えてもらう為クイズを出題しているらしい。更に近々大会があり、開催日は10月31日。トリック・オア・トリートは鳥取or島根だったってこと!?

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: ハチ公の真歴史を探しに、昭和8年の渋谷駅へやって来たトキオとカレン。さっそく駅前で誰かを待っている犬を発見。ところがよく見ると、犬の鼻にはスズメバチが止まっていて…。え？ もしかしてこの蜂がハチ公なの!? アクダーマも、またまた真歴史を潰そうとお邪魔をしてきた！

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: 真歴史を探しに1492年のスペイン・パロス港へやって来たトキオとカレンは、さっそくコロンブスの船『サンタマリア号』へ乗り込む。今回は、まんまとトキオ達を船の牢屋へ閉じ込めることに成功したアクダーマ。このチャンスに真歴史を阻止しようとコロンブスに近づくのだが、やること成すこと裏目に出てしまい…。

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: 1898年のニューヨークへやって来たトキオとカレン。ドーナツを食べていると、オオカミ王『ロボ』を連れたシートンが現れた。何やらノートにメモを取っているが、表紙に書かれたタイトルは…シートンドーナツ記!? ドーナツフェスに参加するシートンとトキオたち。そこへやっぱりアクダーマもお邪魔をしてきた！

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: 『地球は青かった』という名言で有名なガガーリンの真歴史を探して、1961年のソビエト連邦へやって来たトキオとカレン。さっそく訓練生に紛れ込むと、なんとそこにはアクダーマの姿が！ 今回はなかなか真歴史反応が無くガガーリンを追いかけて宇宙まで行くことに！ 果たして真歴史は一体!?

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: 織田信長の真歴史を探して、1560年の戦国時代へとやって来たトキオとカレン。清州城へたどり着くと…なんと屋根には巨大なカブトムシ型のしゃちほこが並んでいた！ 門番もフンコロガシ型の兜を被り、更に刀ではなく虫取り網を持っていて…。

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: 鉄砲伝来の真歴史を探しに、1543年の種子島へとやって来たトキオとカレン。漂着した南蛮人から伝来したのは…なんとパンツだった!? ところがアクダーマにパンツを奪われ、このままでは真歴史を見届けることが出来なくなってしまう。そこで、代わりに用意したのは…トキオのパンツ!? お殿様の様子もおかしくて…。

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: ジャンヌ・ダルクの真歴史を探して、1429年のフランス・オルレアンへやって来たトキオとカレン。着いて早々ドロボーに遭遇するが、そこへ現れたフリフリ衣装に身を包む自称魔法少女。え？ もしかして彼女がジャンヌ？ 一方のアクダーマは天使に変装して、ジャンヌに剣を持たせ戦わそうと企むが…。

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: トキオとカレンがやって来たのは2016年のグリーンランド。赤服に白ヒゲの筋肉ムキムキな老人ルドルフとトナカイに出会う。ところがルドルフは、熱を出して倒れてしまった。代わりに、プレゼントを配る決意をしたトキオとカレン。ビマージョは何やらルドルフと因縁があるらしく、仕返ししようと企んでいるのだが…。

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: 1585年の駿河の国へとやって来たトキオとカレン。そこでは服部半蔵が、忍術によく似たイリュージョンで人々を驚かせていた。ところがアクダーマは次々イリュージョンの種を明かし妨害する。人気が無くなり落ち込んでしまうハンゾー。それならあの山の上の城を消しちゃうのはどうかと、トキオからアドバイスを貰い…。

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: 古代ギリシャの都市『クロトン』にあるピタゴラスの定食屋へとやって来たトキオとカレン。まさかピタゴラスの定食が真歴史なんじゃ…と予想するが、バイザーは反応しない。するとからくりを駆使して、ピタゴラスの定食が運ばれてくる。ツブヤッキーとスズッキーはからくりに細工をしてピタゴラスを誘拐しようと企むが…。

episodes.title: Episodio 16
episodes.synopsis: 1589年のイタリア・ピサへやってきたトキオとカレン。ピサの斜塔を斜めに押している、ちょっとぽっちゃりした人々を発見。すると、音楽と共に体を左右に揺らすガリレオ・ガリレイが現れ、自給を上げろとラップを始めた。困ったアクダーマはラップバトルで打ち負かし、天文学の勉強をさせようと企むのだが…。

episodes.title: Episodio 17
episodes.synopsis: 唐の時代の中国へやって来たトキオとカレン。さっそく三蔵法師一行を見つけるが、何やらトラブルの様子。どうやら三蔵が、目で卵を剥けと悟空に無理難題を言って困らせているらしい。アクダーマはというと、三蔵に目を付けられ、甘い言葉にコロッと騙されトップ芸人を目指すことになるのだが…。

episodes.title: Episodio 18
episodes.synopsis: ナスカの地上絵が描かれた時代、紀元前のペルーへやって来たトキオとカレン。すると、地上に絵を描いている青年ナスカと出会う。そこへ現れたアクダーマ。画伯メカを作り出し、絵を描き変えて邪魔をする。ところが、ナスカはぜひ弟子入りさせてほしいと、アクダーマのコックピットに乗り込んでしまった!?

episodes.title: Episodio 19
episodes.synopsis: 紫式部の真歴史を探して、1008年の平安京へとやって来たトキオとカレン。さっそく屋敷を訪ねると、なぜか表札には部員募集の文字。紫色の着物を身にまとった女性達が現れると、桃色のカレンの姿に驚いてひっくり返る。ビマージョは部長になって実権を握り、部活動も真歴史も同時にぶっ潰そうと企むのだが…。

episodes.title: Episodio 20
episodes.synopsis: 真歴史を探して幕末の京都へやって来たトキオとカレン。するとダンダラ羽織を着た侍たちが、両手で顔を覆いながら走り抜けていく。その中の一人、石につまづき転ぶ土方。なんとその顔は…超美形なイケメン。振り返った近藤や沖田もみなイケメンだった。

episodes.title: Episodio 21
episodes.synopsis: 18世紀のフランス、ヴェルサイユ宮殿へとやって来たトキオとカレン。さっそく部屋の中に入ると、何やらカジュアルな服装の少女が婦人相手に接客をしていた。え？ あの娘がマリーアントワネット!? アクダーマは教科書歴史通り、マリーに贅沢三昧の生活を送らせようと企むのだったが…。

episodes.title: Episodio 22
episodes.synopsis: 月面着陸の真歴史を探し、1969年のアメリカへやって来たトキオとカレン。ところが着いた場所はハリウッド。黒スーツを着た男たちの目を盗み撮影スタジオへ入り込むと…そこにあったのは月面のセット!? 途方に暮れるアクダーマ。ビマージョは、それなら自分たちが月に行って撮影すればいいと企むのだが…。

episodes.title: Episodio 23
episodes.synopsis: 1820年のトスカーナ大公国へやって来たトキオとカレンは、生まれたばかりのナイチンゲールに出会う。その後の成長した時代へタイムボカンを繰り返し、真歴史を探るのだが…。大人になるにつれ、どんどん高飛車になっていくナイチンゲール。すると、カレンのバイザーが反応して…。え？ これが今回の真歴史!?

episodes.title: Episodio 24
episodes.synopsis: 16世紀のフィレンツェ共和国へやって来たアクダーマ。両手を広げ立つダヴィンチと出会う。ところがよく見ると、後ろには更に手足をずらし並んで立つ姿…その人数なんと24人！ 一緒になって驚くトキオとカレンだが、いきなりメカ戦を仕掛けられる。とっさにタイムボカンをして切り抜けるが…。

info.title: Spicchi di cielo tra baffi di fumo (ITA)
info.synopsis: Tratto dal romanzo I fratelli neri dei coniugi Kurt Held e Lisa Tetzner, pubblicato nel 1941. Romeo no aoi sora ci mostra uno spaccato vivo e crudo della compravendita di minori effettuata nel nostro paese alla fine dell’ottocento. Romeo, un ragazzino che vive sulle Alpi della Svizzera italiana, firma, per pagare il medico al padre malato, un contratto con un losco individuo, che lo condurrà attraverso i monti fino in Italia, a Milano, dove sarà venduto come aiutante di uno spazzacamino. Inizia così il viaggio di Romeo, tra soprusi e violenze.

episodes.title: Festa in un villaggio delle Alpi
episodes.synopsis: Romeo wants to participate in the pole climbing competition, in which several boys compete to get a trophy placed on top of a pole. Meanwhile, Luini, a mysterious man known as the god of death, arrives in the village.

episodes.title: Inizia una nuova vita
episodes.synopsis: The fire started by Luini devastates the only cornfield that Romeo's family has left. Romeo's family rush to the field to try to save the domestic animals, but Roberto injures his head while leaping out of the flames.

episodes.title: Addio montagne
episodes.synopsis: Due to the injures suffered during the fire, Roberto's condition worsens to the point of going blind if he is not treated urgently.

episodes.title: Ricercati
episodes.synopsis: After being treated by doctor Baresi, Roberto will recover and will not go blind. Romeo has sacrificed himself for the sake of his family and must now leave the village.

episodes.title: Una notte d'attesa
episodes.synopsis: Luini locks up the boys before crossing the lake by boat to get to Milan. Among them is Dante, who devises a plan to escape.

episodes.title: La barca è colata a picco
episodes.synopsis: The boat in which Romeo and the others are traveling to Milan is hit by a storm and sinks.

episodes.title: La casa dell'angelo
episodes.synopsis: In Milan, Romeo and Alfredo are sold as chimney sweeps to different bosses, having to separate, but not before swearing eternal friendship. Romeo is taken by Rossi, his buyer, to his house, where he will start a new life.

episodes.title: Il regalo dell'angelo
episodes.synopsis: Cleaning chimneys is harder than Romeo could imagine. And worst of all is that when he comes home tired from work he doesn't get a piece of bread. However, an angel who lives in the house cares for him.

episodes.title: Lettera d'amore al chiaro di luna
episodes.synopsis: Romeo goes to clean Professor Casella's fireplace who, to thank him, gives him an illustrated book.

episodes.title: Il quaderno
episodes.synopsis: Romeo manages to get the key which keeps his door locked, so he can go out to meet Angeletta, becoming friends.

episodes.title: Una nuova amicizia
episodes.synopsis: Romeo watches from the rooftop of a house that one of the Wolf Pack members is ambushed by another gang of boys, but then the rest of the pack appears and a fight breaks out.

episodes.title: Fuga nella nebbia
episodes.synopsis: Romeo finds Anselmo lying on the street and covered in bruises. Anselmo tells Romeo that he confronted Tachioni because he hates outsiders and wants to kick Romeo out of town.

episodes.title: Un incontro inaspettato
episodes.synopsis: Romeo fights the Wolf Pack, who think he has denounced them to the police, but is saved at the last minute by a masked boy.

episodes.title: La conquista della libertà
episodes.synopsis: The carriage Romeo has sneaked into contains explosives that the robbers intend to use to blow up the police station and free their imprisoned friend.

episodes.title: I Fratelli del Camino
episodes.synopsis: After proving his innocence, Romeo's conditions at Rossis' house get better. Marcello gives him a day off and Romeo decides to search for Alfredo in the streets of Milan.

episodes.title: L'esempio di Alfredo
episodes.synopsis: After a long time, Romeo and Alfredo finally reunited and joined other young chimney sweeps to form the Black Brothers fraternity with Alfredo in command to confront the Wolf Pack.

episodes.title: L'imboscata alla chiesa di San Babila
episodes.synopsis: Since the Wolf Pack has no intention of stopping picking on the chimney sweeps, the Black Brothers, fed up with running away, decide to stand up to them.

episodes.title: La grande sfida
episodes.synopsis: As retaliation for losing the fight at San Babila church, Michaelo was kidnapped by the Wolf Pack.

episodes.title: L'arrivo della nonna
episodes.synopsis: Marcello Rossi receives a letter from his mother, Mimi, announcing she will pay them a visit soon.

episodes.title: Le marionette di Teo
episodes.synopsis: Romeo and Angeletta meet the old puppeteer Teo and little Nana.

episodes.title: Il segreto di Angeletta
episodes.synopsis: Matteo tells the boys the story of Marcello Rossi and Angeletta: a countess named Isabella is the girl's grandmother.

episodes.title: A casa della Contessa
episodes.synopsis: Angeletta's greatest wish is to meet her grandmother, the Countess Isabella Montovani, before her serious illness progresses.

episodes.title: Arrivederci angelo mio
episodes.synopsis: Angeletta's condition is deteriorating rapidly. The so-called Ice Queen Montovani wants nothing to do with her granddaughter.

episodes.title: Bianca
episodes.synopsis: In Milan, a wedding of the nobility is taking place and all rich and noble people of the area are invited. Even the king of Italy is expected to come.

episodes.title: La liberazione di Bianca
episodes.synopsis: Alfredo and Bianca are still on the run from their relatives. Their aunt and uncle want the badge that Alfredo hid. This badge was bestowed on Alfredo's father by Carlo Alberto, the father of the current Italian king, and legitimizes the Martini's fortune.

episodes.title: Un animo nobile
episodes.synopsis: Professor Casella discovers that Alfredo's illness is worse than initially thought. Alfredo also knows that he will not live much longer.

episodes.title: Il giorno più lungo
episodes.synopsis: Alfredo wants to restore his honor before the King of Italy and accuse his aunt and uncle of murdering his parents. Unfortunately, the Wolf Pack lure him into a trap and lock him in the sewers.

episodes.title: Il nobile Alfredo

episodes.title: Addio Alfredo

episodes.title: Sulle ali della libertà

info.title: Eren the Southpaw
info.synopsis: Asakura Koichi lavora come designer per un'agenzia pubblicitaria. Anche se si impegna molto per soddisfare la sua compagnia, non riceve mai alcun riconoscimento per il suo lavoro. Questo fa sentire Koichi costantemente frustrato. Un giorno, decide di visitare un luogo che gli ricorda i tempi della sua infanzia con Yamagishi Eren. Eren è dotata di un talento naturale per la pittura, ma per via del suo genio, si ritrova ultimamente a passare dei momenti di sofferenza.

episodes.title: La cucina casalinga e la ragazza
episodes.synopsis: Kazuya e Chizuru hanno deciso di girare un film insieme per farlo vedere a nonna Sayuri. Fin qua tutto ok, ma ora devono sedersi e definire tutti i dettagli.

episodes.title: La ragazza della stanza accanto
episodes.synopsis: Ruka chiede spiegazioni a Kazuya e Chizuru e una nuova ragazza, Mini, sente tutto! Cosa avrà intenzione di fare?

episodes.title: L'esperta e la ragazza
episodes.synopsis: Con il lancio della campagna di crowdfunding in fase di stallo, Kazuya deve rivolgersi a Mini, che si dà il caso sia un'esperta in materia!

episodes.title: L'ultimo giorno e la ragazza
episodes.synopsis: L'appello sincero di Mini rende la situazione imbarazzante. Nel frattempo, Umi fa una richiesta in cambio del retweet della campagna.

episodes.title: Le riprese e la ragazza
episodes.synopsis: Le riprese del film iniziano e, vedendola recitare in carne e ossa, Kazuya si rende conto che Chizuru esiste in una dimensione completamente diversa dalla sua. Nel frattempo, Mini sta preparando un copione tutto suo.

episodes.title: L'ultima scena e la ragazza
episodes.synopsis: Kazuya e Chizuru finiscono in una stazione sciistica e si ritrovano a dover girare da soli la scena finale del film. Chizuru ritiene di aver qualcosa da dire a Kazuya.

episodes.title: Kazuya e la ragazza
episodes.synopsis: È il compleanno di Ruka e Kazuya deve mantenere la parola data e concederle tutto ciò che desidera. Ma cosa vuole davvero?

episodes.title: La famiglia e la ragazza
episodes.synopsis: Sayuri si aggrega a Kazuya e Chizuru per esplorare il cinema in cui proietteranno il loro film, e questo le riporta alla mente alcuni ricordi.

episodes.title: Il commiato e la ragazza
episodes.synopsis: Con le prospettive di Sayuri che appaiono desolanti, Kazuya mette in atto l'unica cosa che può fare per Chizuru e per lei.

episodes.title: Il viaggio inaspettato e la ragazza
episodes.synopsis: Non sapendo cosa fare, Kazuya chiede consiglio alla buona vecchia Sumi. Lei decide di portarlo in viaggio per aiutarlo a schiarirsi le idee.

episodes.title: La ragazza e il ragazzo
episodes.synopsis: Kazuya decide di affittare Chizuru per un giorno intero e organizza un piano di appuntamenti per tirarla su di morale. Avrà successo?

episodes.title: La ragazza ideale e la ragazza
episodes.synopsis: Vedendo Chizuru sopraffatta dal dolore, Kazuya decide di darle uno sfogo e vede il momento che segue come un grande cambiamento nel loro rapporto.

info.title: Psyren
info.synopsis: Ageha Yoshina, uno studente delle superiori, trova una misteriosa scheda telefonica rossa con la scritta Psyren. Poco dopo, la sua compagna di classe Sakurako Amamiya, entrata in possesso di una scheda identica, scompare improvvisamente, lasciando dietro di sé solo un disperato messaggio di aiuto. Spinto dalla volontà di salvarla e di scoprire la verità, Ageha decide di usare la scheda. In questo modo viene trasportato in Psyren, un mondo ostile e pericoloso in cui la sopravvivenza è tutt'altro che garantita. Qui incontra altri partecipanti come lui e scopre di poter risvegliare poteri psichici, indispensabili per affrontare le minacce che lo circondano. Tra combattimenti, prove sempre più dure e misteri irrisolti, Ageha dovrà lottare per restare vivo e trovare un modo per riportare a casa Sakurako.

episodes.title: La leggenda metropolitana
episodes.synopsis: Dopo aver risposto a una chiamata in un telefono pubblico e la scomparsa di una compagna di classe, Ageha inizia a indagare sulla leggenda metropolitana di cui tutti parlano su internet. La chiave è una scheda telefonica rossa su cui appare una singola scritta: Psyren.

episodes.title: Umanità proibita, "tabù"
episodes.synopsis: Il primo gioco ha inizio. Per completarlo, i partecipanti devono raggiungere il Gate, ma non è tutto semplice come sembra. Con l'aiuto di Amamiya, Ageha comprende un po' meglio cosa deve affrontare.

episodes.title: Psi
episodes.synopsis: Ageha and his friends have ended up in a death game. While heading for the finish line, before they can make it to safety, an unworldly monster calls a Taboo appears before them.

episodes.title: Recall
episodes.synopsis: In a bid for survival, Ageha undergoes PSI training. Meanwhile, the actor Oboro and opportunistic Kabuto also receive phone cards.
